title: Absence of sperm on rape victim’s clothes no ground to discredit her testimony: J&K High Court
description: The Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh High Court recently observed that the absence of sperm on the clothes of a rape victim cannot be a ground to disbelieve or discredit her testimony.Justice Sanjay Dhar made the observation while cancelling the bail granted by a trial court to a rape accused.
